discovery: Opponents in preserved histories, excluding trained targets; descending eligible appearance count, then SHA256(seed:username). No model predictions used.
sampling: Newest complete eligible games, prefix under decision cap; shared games belong to the first accepted player. Quality subset: seeded whole-game prefix per player.
interpretation: Unseen-player histories are independent target players, not necessarily later than training. Report strict post-original-cutoff and known-player temporal subsets separately. Models, profile and temperatures remain frozen.
